title: War of the Damned
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Anya! Captain Bandarion! Over here!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lady Sylvanas, what the hell is that thing?!
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Lady Sylvanas, what the hell is that thing?![/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Naxxramas. An ancient necropolis repurposed into a flying fortress, home to the archlich Kel'Thuzad.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: It boasts immense destructive power, but leveling the city's ruins was not the Scourge's goal.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: That blast breached the surface, creating an entrance to the Undercity. They seek to invade and reclaim it from the Forsaken.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: I can keep the skies clear, but their ground forces are on the march. Our forward defenses will only hold for so long.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll reinforce them with whatever forces we can muster.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge will not reach the Undercity, Dark Lady. This I swear.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Good. Now go. The fate of the Forsaken is in your hands.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Your arrival was timely, Leonid. And unexpected.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: We guessed at the Scourge's intentions when we saw Naxxramas make way toward the Undercity. It cannot be allowed to remain aloft.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scourge have deployed their forces via skybarge. If we were to commandeer one, we could use it to reach the necropolis.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A skybarge can only transport a few of us at a time. How do we destroy Naxxramas once we're up there?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I might be able to help with that.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: These are the explosives I hand out to my demolition crews.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: If you detonate them at key structural locations, that entire eyesore will collapse in on itself.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems you’ve saved us all, my friend.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=3 v3=3.0 easein=0.25 easeout=0.25]It seems you’ve saved us all, my friend.[/"Happy"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Just returning the favor.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=3 v3=3.0 easein=0.25 easeout=0.25]Just returning the favor.[/"Happy"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Then our course of action is clear. Garek, I entrust you with Naxxramas's destruction.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The rest of our unlikely alliance will defend the Undercity until you return.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold GameplayStart Q
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Rally what forces you can. There may also be others across the battlefield who require your aid.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold WayToBulwarks Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Stopping the ground assault won't accomplish anything if Naxxramas fires on us again.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold WayToBulwarks Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then we'll have to find a way to bring it down.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold ReachingBulwarks Q
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion! We've secured positions at two other bridges, but they won't hold for long!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold ReachingBulwarks Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll deploy additional troops as needed. Stand strong until we have no choice but to fall back!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Optional Quest - Stranded.Transmission Stranded 01 Rescue Q
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Good of you to join the fight, Captain Bandarion!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Optional Quest - Stranded.Transmission Stranded 02 Rescue Q
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: These Scourge maggots are going to regret attacking our home!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Optional Quest - Stranded.Transmission Stranded 04 Rescue Q
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Heh. It takes more than this to defeat the Forsaken!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold MeatWagons Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: These meat wagons are on the high ground. Our workers can repair them and bolster our defenses.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold BridgeLost1 Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: This bridge is lost! Fall back while I cover you!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold BridgeLost2 Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: We cannot hold this position! Head back to the Undercity!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold BridgeLost3 Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: There are too many of them! Retreat while you still can!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold NoEndToThem Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Is there no end to them?!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold NoEndToThem Q
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Hold your ground! If we falter here, the Forsaken are lost!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold ArgentDawnArrives Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Knights of the Argent Dawn! Strike down these Scourge heathens!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold ArgentDawnArrives Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That's Leonid! The Argent Dawn have joined the battle!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold Completed Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We've secured the ruins! Regroup at the entrance to the Undercity!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky Discover Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I will join you for the assault on Naxxramas. I may know where the explosives will do the most damage.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky WayToScourgeBase Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid, how do you know where to place the explosives?

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky WayToScourgeBase Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I have walked the halls of Naxxramas before... as one of the Scourge. I still remember everything I saw within it.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky WayToScourgeBase Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You were at Stratholme, then. That's where it was brought after being torn Northrend's frozen wastes.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky WayToScourgeBase Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme... why do I...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky WayToScourgeBase Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No. It's not important now. All that matters is our mission.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky GateEnemies Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We have to reach the skybarge fast or we'll be overwhelmed!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky Update1 Q
lines.speaker: Necromancer Morkath
lines.text: Intruders! Your traitorous kind will kneel to the Scourge!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Skyjack.Transmission Sky Update2 Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Quickly, to the skybarge! Before reinforcements arrive!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold DeathKnightAttacked Q
lines.speaker: Death Knight
lines.text: Let terror reign!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold LichAttacked Q
lines.speaker: Lich
lines.text: Embrace the end!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Main Quest - Hold the Line.Transmission Hold CryptLordAttacked Q
lines.speaker: Crypt Lord
lines.text: The Scourge will devour all!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Optional Quest - Stranded.Transmission Stranded 03 Rescue Abomination Q
lines.speaker: Abomination
lines.text: What we do?
